plan_title: SSPLAN-507 Test Plan — Display Gap to Close

results.test: Primary Display Gap to Close  render path
results.steps: Open target route with valid fixture/user context.
results.assertion: Expected primary content appears with correct title/value labels and no console/runtime error.
results.evidence: No live server was available in this run. To verify manually, open `/hfb/:id` and `/hfb/:hfbId/pa/:paId` from frontend/src/App.tsx:33-36 and confirm the snapshot gap row renders the expected title/value/gap text without UI breakage. Relevant source path: frontend/src/features/entity-detail/HFBDetailPage.tsx:81-107,139,171-184,207; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/PADetailPage.tsx:67-82,118,152-161,171-173.

results.test: Interaction path for Display Gap to Close
results.assertion: State transition completes within 1 click/gesture and target view/data updates correctly.
results.evidence: No live server was available in this run. To verify manually, open `/hfb/:id` and `/hfb/:hfbId/pa/:paId` from frontend/src/App.tsx:33-36 and confirm navigating between HFB and PA updates the gap text and snapshot values correctly. Relevant source path: frontend/src/features/entity-detail/HFBDetailPage.tsx:81-107,139,171-184,207; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/PADetailPage.tsx:67-82,118,152-161,171-173.

results.steps: Return empty dataset or no eligible rows.
results.assertion: Fallback/empty message is shown and layout remains stable (no broken placeholders).
results.evidence: Empty/missing KPI values degrade to placeholders instead of breaking layout: HFB uses `Math.abs(100 - real.ytdIndex)` with `"-"` fallback and PA renders `"Gap to close: - pts"` (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/HFBDetailPage.tsx:81-107,139,171-184,207; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/PADetailPage.tsx:67-82,118,152-161,171-173); SnapshotCard renders the gap row only when `gapMessage` is supplied (frontend/src/features/overview/SnapshotCard.tsx:43,103,166-173).

results.assertion: Error state is user-visible, recoverable on retry, and does not hard-crash route.
results.evidence: Page-level failures surface through `ErrorBanner` retry UI in the detail pages (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/HFBDetailPage.tsx:81-107,139,171-184,207; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/PADetailPage.tsx:67-82,118,152-161,171-173), but the gap-close row itself has no dedicated error-specific state or retry contract.

results.steps: Run representative fixture values through transform/mapping layer.
results.assertion: Scaled and raw fields retain expected precision (sales scaled where applicable, index untouched).
results.evidence: The gap value is derived directly from the KPI delta in source via `Math.abs(100 - real.ytdIndex)` before rendering the `Gap to close` string (frontend/src/features/entity-detail/HFBDetailPage.tsx:81-107,139,171-184,207).

results.steps: Feed out-of-order and duplicate-key fixture records.
results.assertion: Output order and uniqueness follow deterministic rule (documented sort/dedupe behavior).
results.evidence: The plan expects an ordering/identity rule, but this implementation exposes only a scalar gap row via `SnapshotCard`; there is no collection transform or dedupe rule to validate for this feature path.
results.failure_reason: No ordering/dedupe transform for gap-close feature

results.steps: Inspect generated request payload and query params for this feature path.
results.assertion: Metric/level/filters are populated exactly as expected for selected hierarchy context.
results.evidence: The request contract is incomplete for the stated hierarchy coverage: only `fetchSalesIndexToGoalForHfb` exists and it sends HFB filters (frontend/src/services/metricsApi.ts:12-14,172-215,244-257,289-297); the country overview explicitly says there is no country-level KPI metric and renders placeholders instead (frontend/src/features/overview/OverviewPage.tsx:311-328,343-383,435-450,518-529,600-605).
results.failure_reason: Gap-close request contract incomplete by hierarchy

results.steps: Compare required FE keys against backend response schema fixture.
results.assertion: Missing or renamed required keys fail with explicit diff and actionable message.
results.evidence: Fallback placeholders exist in `SnapshotCard`/detail pages (frontend/src/features/overview/SnapshotCard.tsx:43,103,166-173; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/HFBDetailPage.tsx:81-107,139,171-184,207; frontend/src/features/entity-detail/PADetailPage.tsx:67-82,118,152-161,171-173), but there is no explicit response-schema diff guard for missing KPI keys.
